// zod 4's util.js BIGINT_FORMAT_RANGES construction, and the checks over it
export const BIGINT_FORMAT_RANGES = {
  int64: [/* @__PURE__*/ BigInt("-9223372036854775808"), /* @__PURE__*/ BigInt("9223372036854775807")],
  uint64: [/* @__PURE__*/ BigInt(0), /* @__PURE__*/ BigInt("18446744073709551615")],
};
function check(format, input) {
  const [minimum, maximum] = BIGINT_FORMAT_RANGES[format];
  if (typeof input !== "bigint") return "expected bigint, got " + typeof input;
  if (input < minimum) return "too small";
  if (input > maximum) return "too big";
  return "ok";
}
console.log(BIGINT_FORMAT_RANGES);
console.log(check("int64", 3));
const v = BIGINT_FORMAT_RANGES.uint64[1];
console.log(typeof v, v === 18446744073709551615n, String(v), `${v}`, v + 1n, [v].includes(18446744073709551615n));
try {
  JSON.stringify({ a: 1n });
} catch (e) {
  console.log(e.name, e.message);
}
let any1 = 7n;
any1 = any1 * 6n;
console.log(any1, Object.is(any1, 42n));
